answer: Age-Tiered Visibility Delay. Each identity's visibility rises as a prism of accumulated unique-interaction history; new identities start dim and brighten only as distinct counterparties transact across separate periods. A river of repeat spam cannot substitute, since each fresh identity re-enters at the dim tier. Attacker cost is linear: every parallel identity must independently fund and sustain genuine multi-period interactions, so the oasis of reachable fake accounts shrinks with each tier crossed.
